Name: Orca Sessions
Description: Shows live Orca agent sessions and remaining Claude/Codex limits on your keys.

Actions.Name: Session slot
Actions.Tooltip: Place on several keys. Orca sessions fill them in order.

Actions.Name: More sessions
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the next page when there are more sessions than keys.

Actions.Name: Remaining limit
Actions.Tooltip: Remaining Claude or Codex 5-hour / weekly limit.

Actions.Name: Claude buddy
Actions.Tooltip: Claude character that reacts to all sessions. Press to jump to the most urgent one.

Localization.Shared note: These settings apply to every session key. Slot order is set per key.
Localization.Usage note: Reads the login that Claude Code and Codex already use, and sends it only to their own usage endpoints. Press the key to switch between used and remaining.
Localization.Replies note: Hold a session key to open its detail page. When the agent is idle, these appear as buttons (one per line, up to 4).
Localization.Buddy note: Reacts to all sessions: waves when someone needs you, types while agents work, celebrates when one finishes, dozes when all are idle, sweats when a limit is nearly used up. Press to jump to the most urgent session.
